Error Handling
[SWS_FrArTp_00039] DL field ⌈Incoming FF-I frames with DL = 0x000 shall be ig-
nored. Moreover, if the DL value is lower than the possible (from the PDU size, the
addressing type and the channel specific Long Messages switch derivable) payload of
a SF, the frame shall also be ignored.
If acknowledgment is configured, in all the cases above additionally an AF with a neg-
ative acknowledgement shall be sent back to the sender.⌋
